rows.label: tlk70000015_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Hello, welcome. Are you looking for
any instruments?

rows.label: tlk70000015_01_msg0002
rows.name:
Beginners are fine too. The Iiran
Viella is easy to handle, so I
recommend it.

rows.label: tlk70000015_01_msg0003
rows.name:
It's not got many strings, so it's
simple to learn. There are also lots
of good beginner songs. It's a winner!

rows.label: tlk70000015_01_msg0004
rows.name:
Once you've learned some pieces,
you can join an ensemble! It's a
good way to improve in a hurry.

rows.label: tlk70000015_01_msg0005
rows.name:
We've even got a special event where
people play the Iiran Viella to
express thanks to the Divine Beast.

rows.label: tlk70000015_01_msg0006
rows.name:
Its rich, spreading tone is stunning.
Listen if you get the chance, and if
you're interested, pick one up.
